criteria.reason: Skip is an action icon on the exercise card, not an option in the exercise menu.
The skip handler applies immediately without a confirmation prompt.
The finish endpoint writes each submitted set for a skipped exercise with status "skipped".
The card uses the "Skipped" label when the exercise is marked skipped.
The same-session action toggles skip off, and the card exposes an undo-skip control.
The existing finish endpoint handles skipped exercises.
The diff adds no server test for skip or unskip.
The diff adds no client test for skip UI.
The harness reports all existing server and client tests passing.
The added UI labels use direct wording and contain no exclamation marks.
